sections.Profile:
The "Surf 'n Safari" pinball machine, produced by Gottlieb in 1991, offers players a lively amusement park and water-themed experience. The game is equipped with two flippers, three pop bumpers, and various targets, including two vertical up-kickers and a rollunder spinner. Designed by Jon Norris and featuring artwork by David Moore and the Mitchells, the machine immerses players in a dynamic, beach-themed adventure.
